worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.summary: Stand still and send a low shadow crawling along the real ground in the aimed direction, rising and falling with the steps it crosses. The first enemy that steps onto the shadow is flicked from its rear. Cliffs, solid walls and water make the shadow collapse back, so it only catches the one enemy standing on the ground and neither pierces walls nor chases the air.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.0: Crawl a short shadow along the ground and stab the first enemy in the way
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.1: Strike first around nearby terrain edges (it stops at solid walls)
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.2: Flick the back side of a target standing on the ground
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.descriptio: The shadow blade flicks up from behind the first enemy that steps onto it for about %1$s physical damage; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

The shadow crawls about %1$s blocks along the real ground at %2$s blocks/tick with a ground-hugging hit radius of about %3$s blocks; it only catches the first enemy in the way and collapses at cliffs, solid walls and water.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.growth.0: At level %1$s the shadow blade rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.growth.1: At level %1$s the shadow blade rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.preference: It reaches for targets within this distance; the shadow runs along the ground, so larger values mean opening from further out.
On: below three tenths health the target is finished with this stab; off: it ranks as an ordinary candidate.
On: prefer targets whose actual facing is away from the caster (their back toward it); off: ignore facing.
